documents.title: Nordair: Baggage Allowance
documents.text:
NORDAIR: BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE

Each passenger may check one bag of up to 23 kg free of charge and carry one cabin bag of up to 8 kg. Additional checked bags are charged at 60 euros each when added at the airport and 45 euros when added online at least 24 hours before departure. A bag weighing between 23 kg and 32 kg incurs an overweight fee of 12 euros for each kilogram above 23 kg, regardless of the fare or the time of payment; bags over 32 kg are not accepted.

Sports equipment and musical instruments count as checked bags, except that one violin-sized instrument may be carried in the cabin if it fits under the seat. Passengers travelling on Flex fares receive two free checked bags.

Fees paid at the airport are not refundable unless they were charged as the result of an error by airline staff. Passengers who are unsure which fare they hold should check their booking confirmation, which lists the baggage included in the price.

documents.title: Baggage charges on flight NO 218
documents.text:
To: Nordair Customer Care
From: Kenji Tanaka
Subject: Baggage charges on flight NO 218

Dear Sir or Madam,

On 3 November I flew from Oslo to Lisbon on flight NO 218. At the airport I was charged 120 euros for baggage: 60 euros for a second checked bag and 60 euros for the weight of my first bag, which the scales showed to be 28 kg. I had purchased a Flex fare, as shown on my booking confirmation, and the agent at the desk did not appear to believe me. I would like a full refund of the 120 euros.

Sincerely,
Kenji Tanaka

documents.title: Re: Baggage charges on flight NO 218
documents.text:
To: Kenji Tanaka
From: Sigrid Holm, Customer Care
Subject: Re: Baggage charges on flight NO 218

Dear Mr. Tanaka,

Thank you for contacting us, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We have examined your booking, which confirms that you travelled on a Flex fare. Your second bag should therefore have been carried free of charge, and the airport charge for it was an error on the part of our agent. We will refund that amount to your card within seven working days.

I regret that we cannot refund the second charge. The overweight fee applies to every fare, and your first bag exceeded the limit by five kilograms.

With kind regards,
Sigrid Holm

choices: To ask for baggage fees to be returned to him
To complain about the delay of his flight
To dispute the weight recorded for his cabin bag
To ask whether he may carry an instrument
questions.explanation: He says he was charged 120 euros wrongly and asks for a full refund.

questions.explanation: The second-bag charge of 60 euros was an error because Flex fares include two free bags. The overweight fee of 5 kg x 12 = 60 euros was correct and is not refunded.

choices: It was paid online rather than at the airport

questions.explanation: Additional checked bags are bags carried over and above the free allowance.

choices: He travelled from Oslo to Lisbon

questions.explanation: A Flex fare gives two free checked bags, so his entitlement was not limited to one. His bag weighed 28 kg (limit 23 kg).

documents.title: Messages with Ahmed Saleh, Veloce Logistics
documents.text:
Ahmed Saleh: Lena, bad news about order 7714. The container is held at Port Halden. Customs have flagged one pallet for inspection, and the whole container stays put until they are done.
Lena Vogel: How long will that take?
Ahmed Saleh: Typically five to eight working days. If nothing is found, it is released the same day. Best case, your new arrival date is 12 December.
Lena Vogel: That is after our promotional week, which starts on 8 December.
Ahmed Saleh: I know. The container is sealed, so I cannot release the other pallets. What I can do is air-freight 40 of the 200 units from the supplier's warehouse, which would arrive on 5 December. The cost would be 1,900 euros.
Lena Vogel: I will check with my manager and let you know today.

documents.title: Order 7714: options
documents.text:
To: Ivan Petrov, Head of Retail
From: Lena Vogel, Purchasing
Subject: Order 7714: options

Ivan,

Our shipment of 200 kettles is delayed at customs and will not arrive before 12 December at the earliest, which is after our promotion begins. Ahmed has also confirmed that any inspection fee will be borne by the supplier, not by us. He has offered to fly 40 units in by 5 December for 1,900 euros. The kettles sell at 55 euros each during the promotion and cost us 31 euros each, so we would make a margin of 24 euros per unit, before freight.

As I see it, we have three choices: wait and run the promotion on other products for the first week; air-freight 40 units and sell them in the first days; or move the promotion back by a week. The third option would require us to renegotiate the advertising space we have already booked. I would recommend the first or third, since the margin on 40 kettles would not cover the freight cost.

Lena

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Vogel say about the air-freight option?
choices: Forty kettles would earn less than the freight costs
It would deliver all 200 kettles before the promotion
It would be cheaper than waiting for the container
It depends on a decision that customs has not made
questions.explanation: Forty units at a margin of 24 euros give 960 euros, which is less than the 1,900-euro freight cost.

questions.prompt: Why is the delay a problem for Ms. Vogel's company?
choices: Customs has refused to release the goods
The supplier cannot deliver the units on time
The kettles arrive after the promotion starts
The advertising has not yet been booked
questions.explanation: The earliest arrival is 12 December, whereas the promotion begins on 8 December.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Saleh's message imply about the pallets in the container?
choices: They have all been returned to the supplier
They will be inspected one at a time
They cannot be sent on until the inspection is over
They have been replaced by pallets from another order
questions.explanation: The container is sealed and 'stays put until they are done' with the flagged pallet, so the other pallets cannot be released separately.

questions.prompt: The phrase "best case" in the text messages is closest in meaning to
choices: average situation
final decision
usual length of a delay
most hopeful result
questions.explanation: Mr. Saleh says that if nothing is found, 12 December is the earliest and so most favourable date.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned among the choices that Ms. Vogel sets out?
choices: Delaying the start of the promotion
Cancelling the order with the supplier
Selling other goods during the first week
Flying in part of the shipment
questions.explanation: Her three choices are to wait and promote other products, to air-freight 40 units, or to move the promotion back; cancelling the order is not discussed.

documents.title: Offer of a place
documents.text:
University of Westmark
Admissions Office

Dear Ms. Okoro,

We are delighted to offer you a place on the BSc Environmental Science programme beginning on 21 September. The offer is conditional on your achieving grades of AAB in your final examinations and providing evidence of English language proficiency if requested.

Tuition for the first year is 9,200 euros. To accept the offer, please confirm by 15 May through the applicant portal. Applicants who have accepted the offer and who apply for university accommodation by 1 June are guaranteed a room; applications received after that date will be placed on a waiting list. Accommodation fees are charged for the 36-week academic year, in three equal instalments.

Please note that all offers are subject to the University's standard terms and conditions, which are available on our website. We look forward to welcoming you.

Yours sincerely,
Dr. Paul Reiner

documents.title: Minimum Wage to Rise by 7 Percent
documents.text:
The national minimum wage will rise on 1 April from 11.40 euros to 12.20 euros an hour, the government announced yesterday, an increase of about 7 percent. The rate for workers under 21 will rise from 8.80 to 9.40 euros. The measure, which follows a year in which consumer prices rose by 4.5 percent, is expected to benefit around 1.6 million employees.

Business groups gave the announcement a mixed reception. The hospitality federation warned that restaurants and hotels, which employ the largest proportion of minimum-wage workers, would have little choice but to raise prices or reduce hours. Union leaders argued that the increase merely restores purchasing power eroded by inflation, and the finance minister said that the government would review the impact on employment after six months.

Economists note that when the minimum wage rises, employers often also raise the pay of staff slightly above the minimum, in order to preserve differences between jobs. Whether that happens this time will depend on how tight the labour market is.

documents.title: Pay review from 1 April
documents.text:
To: All restaurant managers
From: Finance Director, Harbour Dining Group
Subject: Pay review from 1 April

In light of the announced increase in the minimum wage, hourly pay for all staff will be reviewed from 1 April. Current rates are: kitchen assistant 11.40 euros; server 11.80 euros; senior server 12.60 euros; team leader 14.20 euros.

Anyone whose rate would otherwise fall below the new minimum will be raised to it. We have also decided that team leaders will receive a 3 percent increase, to preserve their margin over other staff. No change will be made to senior servers' rates for the time being. Managers should not discuss these changes with staff before the formal announcement on 10 March.

For budgeting: we employ 18 kitchen assistants and 40 servers across all sites, each working about 25 hours a week on average.

questions.prompt: What does the article suggest that employers may do after a minimum-wage rise?
choices: Replace permanent staff with younger workers
Ask the government for lower taxes on salaries
Ban hospitality workers from working long hours
Raise wages for some jobs above the minimum
questions.explanation: The article notes that employers often raise the pay of staff slightly above the minimum 'to preserve differences between jobs'.

questions.prompt: Which groups of employees at Harbour Dining Group will be raised only to the new minimum?
choices: Servers and senior servers
Senior servers and team leaders
Kitchen assistants and servers
Only kitchen assistants
questions.explanation: Kitchen assistants (11.40) and servers (11.80) are below 12.20 and will be raised to it; senior servers (12.60) are unaffected and team leaders get 3 percent.

questions.prompt: How much more will Harbour Dining Group pay each week for its servers and kitchen assistants combined?
choices: 760 euros
1,520 euros
400 euros
360 euros
questions.explanation: Kitchen assistants: 18 x (12.20 - 11.40) x 25 = 360 euros. Servers: 40 x (12.20 - 11.80) x 25 = 400 euros. Total: 760 euros.

questions.prompt: The word "eroded" in the article is closest in meaning to
choices: suddenly raised
carefully measured
fully restored
gradually reduced
questions.explanation: Union leaders say that inflation has slowly reduced the purchasing power of wages.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about senior servers at the group?
choices: Their pay will be lower than the minimum
Their pay will soon be increased by 3 percent
Their pay will be just above the new minimum
Their pay is the highest in the company
questions.explanation: Their rate stays at 12.60, only 0.40 above the new minimum of 12.20.

TO LET | Weaver Street | Two-bedroom apartment

Bright second-floor apartment close to the station, with a fitted kitchen, balcony and shared garden. Available from 1 February.

Rent: 1,150 euros per month. Service charge: 90 euros per month, covering heating, water and building maintenance.

documents.title: PhotoForge 8
documents.text:
PHOTOFORGE 8 | Professional photo editing, now with AI tools

Price: 79 euros, one-time purchase. Existing PhotoForge 7 owners can upgrade for 39 euros. Prefer to pay as you go? PhotoForge Plus is available by subscription at 6 euros a month and includes cloud storage and all future updates.

System requirements: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer, or macOS 12 or newer; 8 GB of memory (16 GB recommended); 2 GB of free disk space. The AI features, such as automatic background removal and sky replacement, require a graphics card with at least 4 GB of dedicated memory.

Support is available by chat from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 18:00 (Central European Time), and all customers receive free technical help during the first 90 days after purchase. A 14-day free trial is available. Purchases are refundable within 30 days if the software has not been activated on more than one device.

documents.title: PhotoForge support chat
documents.text:
Customer (Mia): Hello. I own PhotoForge 7 and I am thinking of upgrading. My laptop runs Windows 10 with 8 GB of memory and a graphics card with 2 GB.
Support (Tom): Hello Mia. PhotoForge 8 will run on your system, since it meets the minimum requirements. However, the AI features need 4 GB of graphics memory, so they would not be available to you.
Customer (Mia): That is a shame, because those are the main reason I wanted to upgrade. Would the subscription be a better choice?
Support (Tom): The subscription has the same hardware needs, so it would not change that. It also costs more over time: after a few months it would be more expensive than the upgrade.
Customer (Mia): I see. Can I try it first?
Support (Tom): Yes, there is a 14-day trial, and you can then decide. If you do buy it and later change your mind, you can request a refund within 30 days, as long as you have installed it on one computer only.
Customer (Mia): That is helpful. I only have the one laptop, so I should be able to do that.

questions.prompt: Why will Mia be unable to use the AI features?
choices: Her version of Windows is too old
Her graphics memory is too small
She has too little free disk space
She has only a trial licence
questions.explanation: The AI features require 4 GB of dedicated graphics memory; Mia's card has 2 GB.

choices: After 5 months

After 13 months
After 7 months
questions.explanation: The upgrade costs 39 euros; at 6 euros a month the subscription reaches 42 euros after seven months (36 after six).

choices: She will immediately buy the full version
She will probably try the software first
She will cancel her existing PhotoForge 7 licence
She will ask for a refund of her upgrade
questions.explanation: After being told she can try the software for 14 days, she is left to decide afterwards; she asks 'Can I try it first?'.

choices: To help a customer decide on an upgrade

questions.explanation: Mia explains her computer's specifications and asks whether upgrading or subscribing would suit her.

questions.explanation: Dedicated graphics memory is memory used only by the graphics card rather than shared with the rest of the system.
